caseName: North Carolina Natural Gas Corp. v. McJunkin Corp.
caseNameFull: North Carolina Natural Gas Corp. v. McJunkin Corporation
attorneys: Eugene Gressman for petitioner., John H. Anderson, Willis Smith, Jr., Arthur G. Stone and Donald O. Blagg for respondent.
judges: Amendment, Because, Black, Constitution, Granted, Guaranteed, Right, Should, Trial

opinions.text:
C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari denied.

Mr. Justice Black is of the opinion that certiorari should be granted in this case because the petitioning North Carolina Natural Gas Corporation has been denied its right to a trial by jury guaranteed by the Seventh Amendment to the Constitution.
